knowledge_graph.merchant_description: "Located just off SR 520 on the Banana River in Cocoa Beach, Cape Canaveral Hospital features 150 beds and 240 highly skilled Medical Staff members. It also boasts a 21-bed Level II Emergency Department and an adjoining six-story Medical Plaza that includes physician's offices, a conference center, pre-operative testing, outpatient registration for laboratory testing and same-day surgery, as well as a Health Resource Center for the community."
